root_causes.category: Premature Q2 Land Expansion & Capital Dilution
root_causes.evidence: Buying Q2 in X1.10 drops final cash from ~19.4k (Q0+Q1 counterfactual) to ~0-743 (baseline X1.10). Q2 adds $2000 land cost, over $18k extra seed/product spend, and dilutes worker focus without increasing harvest throughput.
root_causes.causal_mechanism: Q2 activation triggers aggressive planting of high-cost seeds across 75 tiles. Workers spend turns moving between Q0, Q1, and Q2 instead of watering and harvesting. Total spend spikes to $77.7k while revenue drops to $15.0k.

root_causes.category: Complete Breakdown of Livestock Milk Monetization
root_causes.evidence: X1.10 spends $4000 on cows (8 cows bought) and feeds them, but performs EXACTLY 0 COLLECT actions. Milk revenue in X1.10 is $0.0 across all seeds (vs $3.4k in X1.9).
root_causes.causal_mechanism: Workers never visit pasture tiles to perform COLLECT. The $4000 cow purchase + wheat feed costs are 100% pure capital loss with zero return.

root_causes.evidence: _x110_required_wheat_buffer triggers $7.2k - $27.7k in BUY_PRODUCT Wheat purchases at market prices to maintain buffers for cows that generate zero Milk revenue.
root_causes.causal_mechanism: The strategy buys Wheat at retail prices instead of growing it or capping feed buffers, causing massive cash drain throughout midgame and endgame.

root_causes.category: Low Harvest Frequency per Productive Tile-Day
root_causes.evidence: In Q0+Q1 counterfactual, 915 productive tile-days yield only 188 harvests (0.20 harvests / tile-day). Revenue / tile-day is $43.76 gross, but net contribution is -$3.4 / tile-day due to seed/hire costs.
root_causes.causal_mechanism: Tiles are kept occupied by long-cycle crops or unharvested mature crops because workers are busy watering or moving rather than harvesting.

root_causes.category: Workforce Cost Overhead Without Proportional Throughput
root_causes.evidence: Workforce hires cost $20,400 in Q0+Q1 (6-8 hands). Workers execute 2926 MOVE actions and 973 IDLE/PASS actions.
root_causes.causal_mechanism: Hiring 6-8 hands is expensive. Without tight spatial clustering or automation of harvest/water routes, worker actions are lost in travel distance.
